rules.rule: Hungarian CTA/button text must use imperative form. 'Több tanárt látok' (I see more teachers) is indicative and semantically wrong. Use 'Mutass még több tanárt' (Show me more teachers).
Lithuanian: @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ before 'mokytojas' is correct (genitive noun construction). Do not flag. The variable is already in the correct form; only the following noun may vary by case.
Japanese: @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ is a French genitive construction and is not configured for Japanese. Replace with @TPL_MATIERE_NOM@ (preferred) or @TPL_MATIERE_FIRST_MAJUS_SMART@. Flag as error.
Traditional Chinese (Taiwan): @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ is a French genitive construction not configured for Chinese. Replace with @TPL_MATIERE_FIRST_MAJUS_SMART@. Flag as error.

Global: @TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@ already contains a leading space (ESPACE = space). Do not add a space before this variable. 'Hola @TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@' → 'Hola@TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@'. Applies to all markets using this variable.

South Slavic markets (sr_RS, bs_BA, sr_ME): Missing @TPL_PROF_PRENOM@ after a greeting like 'Zdravo,' is NOT an error. These languages have 7 noun declensions; the name variable cannot be declined into the correct vocative form. A nameless greeting is intentional and linguistically correct. Do not flag variable_missing for @TPL_PROF_PRENOM@ in vocative/greeting position for sr_RS, bs_BA, or sr_ME.
